name: ddd-clean-migration
description: Reusable Codex workflow for broad-to-specific legacy-informed DDD/Clean Architecture discovery and target-system design.

interface.shortDescription: Codex workflow for legacy-informed DDD/Clean discovery and target-system design.
interface.longDescription: A Codex plugin with reusable skills, agents, templates, and scripts for broad discovery, optional per-bounded-context deep-discovery delegation, bounded-context design synthesis, and build-order guidance for a new DDD/Clean target system.
defaultPrompt: Map candidate bounded contexts and relations from this legacy repository, then decide whether per-BC deep discovery should be delegated.
Design the target DDD/Clean model for this bounded context using legacy evidence.
Recommend the build order for the new target system without proposing legacy remediation.
